name: FMC under the Mistletoe 2026

venue.name: Multiple Cities
venue.details: See the locations tab for more information about venue locations

information:
FMC under the Mistletoe will be held in multiple locations across the globe on **Saturday, December 19, 2026 from 17:00 UTC until 21:00 UTC**. Please pay attention to the date and time zone of your location. 

Locations and their respective registration numbers can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCundertheMistletoe2026#81521-locations). For all locations with a field labelled TBD, registrations will be accepted in the order they were submitted in after the location is finalised.

Locations may be added until **December 4, 2026 23:59 UTC** so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local [Delegate](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/delegates).
